tasks.title: Gantry web console brand lockup
tasks.objective: Replace temporary badges and independent wordmarks with the approved shared Gantry concept-23 lockup across auth, navigation, and favicon surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Auth pages use the 102 by 24 bronze #C0985F canonical lockup—four-square concept 23 mark plus title-case Helvetica Neue Gantry—with no bordered G badge or separate wordmark.
The sidebar uses the same 102 by 24 --ink canonical lockup and remains legible in both themes.
Browser icon uses a dark #1B1A18 tile with an off-white #F7F6F4 mark: an SVG favicon served under /ui/.
Existing auth copy, routes, navigation labels, page title, layout, and Google sign-in treatment do not change.
No PWA manifest, unused icon sizes, external image request, duplicate lockup asset, new dependency, API, schema, persistence, configuration, or runtime behavior is added.
